summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) end-to-end: implement API backend, owner UI, and recipient write actions for shared folders, then verify through human UAT.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed and committed. UAT revealed a critical gap (files uploaded to shared folders lacked IPNS records), which was fully fixed — shared file upload, download, and save (both owner and recipient sides) now work correctly with dual-wrapped IPNS keys.

repo: The cipher-box-ci-debug checkout has no .env files and must be seeded from ../cipher-box/ — five files needed: apps/api/.env, apps/web/.env, and others.
Web app falls back to window.location.origin+'/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, causing silent connection failure when API is on a different port.
SDK packages (sdk-core, core, sdk) must be built before the web dev server can start — @cipherbox/sdk resolution fails otherwise.
NestJS watch mode does not reliably pick up DTO changes for OpenAPI spec generation; API must be fully restarted and api-client regenerated for enum changes to propagate.
The GSD gsd-executor agent creates SUMMARY.md and commits per-task; background task kills during dev server startup are a known Claude Code environment artifact, not real failures.
addShareKeys API endpoint was restricted to share owners only; it needed relaxing to allow write-share recipients to add keys to their own share.
The share-key DTO keyType enum ('file' | 'folder') needed a new 'file-ipns' variant to store recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys separately from file content keys.

code.finding: Original shared upload set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — no per-file IPNS record was created, making uploaded files unreadable/uneditable.
Save path used useFolder's updateFile (owner path) for all files; shared files need a separate save callback that goes through the shared write path.
Shared file load threw 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' for files uploaded via shared folder — root cause was missing IPNS record, not legacy format.
VITE_API_URL env var must be set explicitly; omitting it causes web app to call its own origin+/api instead of the API port.
@ApiProperty enum must match the TypeScript union type exactly for OpenAPI spec regeneration to pick up new enum values.
Both request DTO and response DTO @ApiProperty enums need updating when adding a new keyType value, or the generated client will still use the old enum.

workflow: Detached process spawning (nohup/disown) is required for dev servers in Claude Code — background Task processes are killed when the conversation context shifts.
After API DTO changes, the full cycle is: restart API → verify OpenAPI spec reflects new enum → regenerate api-client → TypeScript check.
OTP codes can be retrieved from the running API server logs via grep on the process output file.
For dual-key cryptographic wrapping (owner + recipient), createFileMetadata must be bypassed and the keypair generation inlined so each party gets their own wrapped copy of the IPNS private key.

friction: Background dev server processes were killed repeatedly by Claude Code's task cleanup, requiring multiple restart cycles with detached process workarounds.
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), blocking API startup until .env was updated.
No .env files existed in cipher-box-ci-debug checkout — had to manually create from .env.example then later copy from cipher-box.
Web app connected to wrong API URL (own origin instead of localhost:3000) due to missing VITE_API_URL, diagnosed only after ruling out CORS and other issues.
NestJS watch mode didn't pick up DTO enum change for OpenAPI — wasted a full restart/regenerate cycle before adding @ApiProperty enum annotation.
Git lock file blocked commit mid-session, requiring manual removal.
The api-client regeneration required the API to be fully running with updated code — partial restarts produced stale OpenAPI specs.
open_items: Files uploaded to shared folders before the IPNS fix (with empty fileMetaIpnsName) are permanently inaccessible — no migration or cleanup path implemented.
The 'file-ipns' share_key approach stores recipient-wrapped IPNS keys but there's no cleanup when a share is revoked — revoked recipients retain the share_key entry.
Owner-side editing of shared files was fixed but relies on ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted in the FilePointer being wrapped with owner's key — this assumption is not validated at read time.
The addShareKeys authorization relaxation (recipients can add keys to their own share) was not accompanied by rate limiting or abuse prevention.
30s sync polling for shared folder write actions (plan 27-03 task) was implemented but not verified during UAT.
Silent revocation transition handling in SharedFileBrowser was implemented but not UAT-tested.
